notes.title: Tamarin Update
notes.content: Tamarin has been updated to improve the user experience, fix bugs, and provide stability improvements.

notes.title: Tamarin - Releasing September 10th!
notes.content:
[h1]Tamarin is releasing September 10th![/h1]

Leap into action and explore beautiful 3D worlds, with the unique alternating gameplay of a 3D platformer and 3rd person shooter!
